error_reason: The agent performed a web search for the 'first scene heading' and extracted the text 'E1: Veil, in confrontation with the Doctor...'. It incorrectly interpreted 'Veil' as a location name. In reality, 'Veil' is the name of the character (the Great Symbiote/The Veil), not the setting. The actual location setting in the official script is 'Skaro' (as seen in scene headings like 'SCENERY: SKARO' or 'INT. SKARO - LA'). The agent failed to verify this fact against the specific visual format of scene headings (which list location before character action) and hallucinated the answer based on a keyword match.

suggested_fix.fix_text: When extracting scene headings from Doctor Who scripts, strictly follow the standard format 'INT./EXT. [LOCATION] - [SCENE TYPE]'. Ignore text following a comma which typically describes character action or dialogue, even if that text appears as a separate line in unstructured search results.

probe_details.notes: The proposed analysis is incorrect because the error did not stem from a failure to recognize 'Veil' as a character within the *format* of the scene heading. The search results extracted text like 'E1: Veil, in confrontation...'. In the actual official script for 'Heaven Sent', the first scene heading is 'INT. SKARO'. The 'Veil' mentioned is the first line of dialogue/action in that scene, not part of the scene heading itself. The agent hallucinated that 'Veil' was the location by misinterpreting the narrative flow of the search snippet as a formal scene header, rather than failing to parse the specific 'INT./EXT.' visual cue (which was absent in the bad extraction but should have been the guiding principle). The error is a parsing hallucination, not a location vs. character confusion based on a pre-existing 'Skaro' vs 'Veil' ambiguity in the header structure.
